label: Settings Menu
description: Gantt chart with settings menu and schedulable rows. Best for a tabbed Settings popover with 12 display and behavior switches, 6 languages and 5 time zones, over empty rows waiting to be scheduled.

label: Drag Reorder
description: Gantt chart with drag-to-reorder tree rows. Best for the leanest setup, where one callback adds a drag grip to every tree row and a single setState keeps the new order.

label: Quarter Roadmap
description: Gantt chart with quarter roadmap and rollups. Best for multi month initiatives grouped by workstream, with a toolbar button that drops the next backlog item onto its empty row.

label: Capacity Board
description: Gantt chart with weekly capacity board. Best for teammates grouped by squad with avatar row labels and shaded weekends, where added assignments stack into extra lanes.

label: Task Table
description: Gantt chart with task table and progress. Best for a read only status report whose tree panel adds Owner avatars and Status badges as columns, with rows added from the toolbar.

label: Baseline Tracking
description: Gantt chart with as-built baseline tracking. Best for frozen plan dates ghosted behind actual bars, showing early, late and on time work plus a planned band on a whole group.

label: Dependencies & Milestones
description: Gantt chart with dependency arrows and milestones. Best for a rollout chain where QA waits on 2 build tracks and a zero length sign off gate opens the go live step.

label: Working Days
description: Gantt chart with working-day drag adjustment. Best for moves that land on a weekend or a holiday and settle on the next working day, keeping each task's working-day length.
